Autofill

        

          Fill application forms using your profile, a selected resume, and cover letter. Works for text fields, dropdowns, dates, and skills.
        

        

          AI matching uses the API key selected in Account (e.g. OpenRouter). Select one there, then use Autofill here.
        

        

          
          
        

        

          
          
          
Cover letter file uploads on the page must be done manually (download from Documents).

        

        

          

            Open a job application form, then click below. We fill: name, email, phone, dropdowns (e.g. country, state), date of birth, resume/cover letter text areas, and skill tags where possible.
          

          
          
        

        

          Shortcut: Ctrl + Shift + F on the page (uses profile + last selected resume/cover letter).
